1.

Peace, true peace, amid earth’s sin and strife? Yea, Jesus’ blood gives the heart rest and peace.

2.

Peace, true peace, amid pressing toil and care? On Jesus’ will’s path all unrest flees.

3.

Peace, true peace, when all feels hard and heavy? At Jesus’ heart, there is stillness, calm.

4.

Peace, true peace, where friends are not? Yea, Jesus bears us and our loved ones.

5.

Peace, true peace, when unknown future dawns? We know Jesus, He our vessel steers.

6.

Peace, true peace, in death’s dark domain? Yea, Jesus has subdued death and its power.

7.

It is enough for us: soon earth’s strife shall end And Jesus calls us to eternal peace.
